role: Senior Power BI Developer / BI Technical Lead
responsibilities: Build scalable and business-focused Power BI solutions.
Design optimized data models for enterprise reporting.
Develop advanced SQL queries for complex and historical data extraction.
Translate sophisticated business rules into effective DAX calculations.
Improve report performance, refresh times, and user experience.
Define and promote Power BI development and governance best practices.
Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level developers.
Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-level dashboards and reports using Power BI.
Translate business requirements into intuitive and actionable analytical solutions.
Develop interactive reports that support operational and strategic decision-making.
Build reusable reporting components and standardized visualization patterns.
Publish and maintain reports through Power BI Service.
Ensure dashboards remain accurate, user-friendly, scalable, and aligned with business needs.
Design efficient and maintainable data models for analytics and reporting.
Define relationships, hierarchies, dimensions, facts, and calculation structures.
Apply dimensional modelling and star-schema principles where appropriate.
Improve model performance, usability, and scalability.
Ensure consistency between source data, business logic, and report outputs.
Document data models, dependencies, assumptions, and business rules.
Write, debug, and optimize complex SQL queries for data extraction and analysis.
Work extensively with:
Extract information from multiple source systems.
Validate query results against functional and reporting requirements.
Optimize database interaction and query execution performance.
Design queries for historical dataset extraction.
Implement dynamic date parameters and rolling time-period logic.
Build flexible queries that support evolving reporting periods.
Handle historical comparisons and time-series analysis.
Ensure accurate and consistent treatment of dates across data sources and reports.
Optimize historical data retrieval to reduce unnecessary processing and refresh times.
Integrate customized SQL queries directly into Power BI.
Inject dynamic parameters into SQL queries to control data retrieval.
Push suitable transformations and filters closer to source systems.
Optimize data loads by reducing unnecessary data volume.
Balance query folding, source processing, and Power BI transformations appropriately.
Ensure parameterized data retrieval remains secure, maintainable, and reliable.
Create and maintain foundational and complex DAX measures.
Implement calculations involving:
Troubleshoot incorrect results and context-related calculation issues.
Optimize DAX expressions for performance and maintainability.
Establish naming conventions and calculation standards.
Diagnose and resolve report performance issues.
Optimize:
Identify bottlenecks across the full reporting chain.
Reduce dashboard loading and refresh times.
Ensure a reliable and responsive experience for end users.
Recommend sustainable improvements instead of short-term workarounds.
Manage reports, semantic models, workspaces, and access permissions.
Configure and support Power BI gateways.
Implement and maintain Row-Level Security.
Support scheduled refreshes and investigate refresh failures.
Apply appropriate release, sharing, and workspace management practices.
Contribute to reliable deployment and lifecycle management across environments.
Act as the N4-level technical reference for Power BI and BI development.
Review SQL, DAX, data models, and report implementations.
Mentor junior and mid-level developers.
Define and promote development standards and reusable practices.
Improve consistency across dashboards and reporting solutions.
Support complex technical decisions and escalations.
Contribute to BI governance, documentation, quality, and maintainability.
Work closely with business stakeholders to understand analytical and reporting requirements.
Translate technical data structures into clear and meaningful business insights.
Explain complex calculations and modelling decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
Challenge requirements when necessary and propose effective alternatives.
Ensure delivered solutions support measurable business outcomes.
